Definition: to load up (beasts), i.e. to migrate
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsâʻan, meaning to load up and move away. It appears once, in Isaiah 33:20.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsâʻan matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
